title: Phase-gated multi-region attenuation for session-aware traffic orchestration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Our hosted API gateways currently perform region failover by blunt traffic drains which cause token loss and client-visible stream resets for long-lived sessions (streaming/chat). This produces SLA violations for customers with session continuity requirements and forces higher client-side retry logic. Goal: Implement a phase-gated attenuation protocol for active-active multi-region edge gateways that preserves session continuity for streaming requests, enforces SLO-aligned degradation, and integrates with circuit budgets and load-shedding policies.
background: We already have primitives for cross-region KV sync (ENG-14257) and a continuity broker playbook (ENG-246801). Existing failover tickets focus on blunt cutovers; this ticket designs a controlled attenuation model with three phases (observe, soften, cutover) plus emergency circuit fallback. The approach must: 1) preserve in-flight stream token continuity where possible, 2) avoid global traffic oscillations, 3) respect per-customer latency and availability SLOs, and 4) be operable from Console (rollout, abort, metrics).
implementation_overview: 1) Phase controller service in gateway plane that orchestrates attenuation windows anchored by epoch IDs. 2) Session watermarking: gateways mark session streams with epoch and KV-lease metadata so target regions can claim continuation tokens if within preservation window. 3) Soft-path routing: gradually shift fraction of new connections using weighted routing with per-session affinity. 4) Circuit budget: each region exposes a circuit budget metric and participates in coordinated load-shedding decisions. 5) Observability: new SLO dashboard + synthetic stream probes to verify token stitching and latency percentiles during rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Canary rollout: shift 5% traffic for region A->B for 30m without >1% increase in 99th latency for streaming endpoints
0 token loss for sessions with last-activity < preservation_window (configurable, default 60s) in 98% of cases during a controlled attenuation test
Circuit budget propagation works under partial-network-failure tests and triggers load-shedding with no more than 5% increased 95th latency for non-stream endpoints
Console exposes controls: start attenuation, abort, force cutover, and per-customer override with audit log entries
Playbook validated: runbook steps for operator-driven emergency abort produce deterministic state and dashboards show expected signals
implementation_tasks: Gateway phase-controller: API + state machine + gRPC hooks (Marco)
Session watermark header and KV-lease handshake (runtime team)
Weighted soft-routing algorithm + smoothing window (routing infra)
Circuit budget metric + policy engine + emergency breaker (sre)
Console UI controls + audit trail (console team)
E2E canary test harness and synthetic streaming validator (qa)
Integration tests with Dedicated mode and Private VPC variants (platform)
Load test matrix and cost modeling for attenuation windows (perf)
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Attenuation oscillation when both regions attempt symmetric soft-shifts. Mitigation: leader election for attenuation epochs and hysteresis on weight changes.

Risk: Token-claim races causing duplicate completions or truncated responses. Mitigation: introduce short-lived KV-lease with monotonic epoch IDs and last-writer-wins with tombstones for safe retries.
Risk: Excessive complexity for small customers. Mitigation: provide per-customer opt-in and a default simpler fallback that uses existing blunt cutover for low-volume tenants.
Risk: Observability gaps hide slow regressions. Mitigation: synthetic probes that exercise token stitching every 10s and alert on >0.5% failure rate.
test_plan: Unit tests for phase-controller state transitions and epoch invariants
Integration tests with KV-lease replication (mock inter-region latency)
Chaos tests: drop packets between regions during soft-shift and measure session continuity
Perf tests: regression matrix for 50k concurrent streams during attenuation windows
Canary: staged rollouts per-tenant with rollback automation tied to SLO breaches
runbook_snippet: Operator steps: 1) Start phase-gated attenuation from Console for target region pair and retention window. 2) Monitor synthetic_stream_success_rate, region_circuit_budget, 99p_stream_latency. 3) If synthetic_stream_success_rate < threshold or circuit_budget < emergency_threshold -> abort attenuation and engage emergency breaker. 4) If abort fails, execute manual drain per playbook.
rollout_plan: Week 1: internal dev canaries on staging. Week 2: limited-customer beta (5 tenants). Week 3: gradual expansion to 50% of multi-region customers with live monitoring. Week 4: GA with runtime-2.3 and docs published.
notes: Prefers epoch IDs over timestamps to avoid clock skew issues across regions.
Preservation window default 60s chosen after experiments showing >95% token handoff success at this threshold under 150ms median inter-region latency.
KV-lease replication will piggyback on existing replication channel from ENG-14257; we need a small schema bump to include epoch metadata.
